name: SlideVerse – The Ultimate Slider Block for Gutenberg
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
SlideVerse integrates the power of Swiper.js, the most advanced mobile-friendly slider library, directly into the Gutenberg block editor. With SlideVerse, you can design beautiful, responsive sliders that elevate your website’s visual appeal while remaining user-friendly and feature-rich.

Whether you’re showcasing images, videos, or custom content, SlideVerse adapts to your creative needs with advanced functionality and flexibility.

Key Features

  • Infinite Slider Block: Introduced in version 0.0.2, this feature enables seamless, infinite scrolling for dynamic and engaging slider presentations.
  • Dedicated Slider Block: The SlideVerse Slider block simplifies the process of creating sliders directly within Gutenberg.
  • Responsive and Touch-Enabled: Fully optimized for touch, swipe, and drag interactions on both mobile and desktop devices.
  • Rich Customization Options: Configure autoplay, loop mode, pagination, navigation, and other settings effortlessly.
  • Multi-Content Support: Add any Gutenberg blocks, including images, text, videos, or third-party blocks, to your sliders.
  • Lightweight and Optimized: Ensures high performance without compromising on aesthetics.
  • Advanced Styling Options: Adjust spacing, alignment, and styling to integrate sliders seamlessly with your site’s design.

SlideVerse empowers both beginners and advanced users to craft visually appealing sliders with ease, unlocking endless creative possibilities.

Credits

  • Swiper.js: Built on the advanced Swiper.js library. Learn more at Swiper.js.

Support

For questions, issues, or feedback, please visit the GitHub Repository or create a support ticket in the WordPress plugin directory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and Install:
    • Upload the slideverse folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    • Alternatively, search for SlideVerse in the WordPress plugin repository and install it directly through the admin panel.
  2. Activate:
    • Go to the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress and activate SlideVerse.
  3. Start Creating Sliders:
    • Open the Gutenberg editor, insert the SlideVerse Slider block, and begin building your sliders with your preferred content.
sections.faq:
What is SlideVerse?

SlideVerse is a WordPress plugin designed to create modern, responsive sliders using Swiper.js within the Gutenberg editor. It allows for seamless integration of various content types into sliders.

What is the Infinite Slider Block?

The Infinite Slider Block, introduced in version 0.0.2, allows you to create sliders with infinite scrolling, making it perfect for dynamic and engaging presentations.

Can I use other blocks inside SlideVerse sliders?

Yes! SlideVerse supports all core and third-party Gutenberg blocks, letting you integrate images, text, videos, or custom blocks into your sliders.

Does SlideVerse support mobile devices?

Absolutely. SlideVerse leverages Swiper.js, optimized for touch gestures and swipe navigation, ensuring a seamless user experience on all devices.

How customizable are the sliders?

SlideVerse offers a wide range of customization options, including autoplay, loop mode, pagination, and navigation settings—all accessible directly in the block settings panel.

Does SlideVerse impact website performance?

No, SlideVerse is lightweight and optimized for fast loading, ensuring your sliders look great without slowing down your website.
